dispatch.head: Nuts end a nine-game losing streak against the biggest favorite of the week
dispatch.dek: MFL had the Ligers by 232.7. Nuts won by 176.25. Ashton Jeanty scored 132, Baker Mayfield 104.75, and D.J. Moore, who sat for 94.5 last week, started and scored 93.25. Nuts were 0.75 points from a perfect lineup. It's their first win since Week 1. The Ligers fell out of the tie for first and are now one game clear of seventh.

dispatch.head: Bloodfeast scores 261.75, the lowest score of the season
dispatch.dek: Week 1's low was 274.5. Bloodfeast beat it by going under. Six more moves Thursday through Sunday: Drew Lock, who scored 90 last week, was cut Thursday for Jalon Daniels, who was cut Sunday for Josh Johnson. Josh Cameron came in Sunday at 10:27 and scored 33 on the bench. The perfect lineup, 304.5, still loses by 338.25. That's the fourth $50 penalty of the season, and $200 to the pool.

dispatch.head: Trash posts the week's high and cuts Cooper Kupp
dispatch.dek: Dak Prescott scored 190.75, the best of anyone this week. Brock Purdy added 123.75 and Trash scored 788 to beat the Diamond Dogs by 259.25. On Friday, after two weeks of benching him for Tre Tucker, Trash cut Cooper Kupp. Rachaad White ($2) started and scored 0.00. Trash and 720 are both 8-3. 720 leads on points, 7,590 to 7,520.5.

dispatch.head: Prestige spends $524 on the quarterback Bloodfeast let go
dispatch.dek: Bloodfeast claimed Joe Milton for $36 three weeks ago and cut him for Drew Lock last week. Prestige bid $524 on him Wednesday, started him Sunday, and got 38.75. That's $13.52 a point. Last week's preview said start Kamara, Downs and Tyson. Prestige started Tyson, who scored 6.5, and benched the other two. 397.5, and 2-9.

dispatch.head: The Wet Bandits pay $51 to bring back the tight end they cut
dispatch.dek: Last week the Wet Bandits cut Dallas Goedert and spent $82 on Mack Hollins and Corey Kiner. This week they cut both and spent another $82 on Goedert and Elic Ayomanor. That's $164 to end up with the tight end they started with. Goedert scored 28.5. Ayomanor scored 20.25 on the bench. Fernando Mendoza scored 127.75 on the bench too. They won by 265.5 anyway: Jonah Coleman ($4) 144, Patrick Mahomes 141.

dispatch.head: Wad of Hell starts Cam Ward and wins by 381
dispatch.dek: Last week Cam Ward scored 107.25 on the bench. This publication said he goes in the lineup. He went in and scored 118.5. Javonte Williams ($14) added 101.5 and Antonio Williams, a bench player last week, 91.5. Wad of Hell scored 642.75 and beat Bloodfeast by 381, the third-biggest margin of the season. They're 7-4, and the Diamond Dogs are next.

takes.0001: 261.75, the lowest score of the season, beating Week 1's 274.5 by going under it. The moves keep coming: Myles Price and Michael Mayer Thursday, Jalon Daniels Thursday night for Drew Lock, the one pickup that worked last week. Mark Andrews Friday, started, 10.5. Josh Johnson Sunday morning for Jalon Daniels, who never played a down for them. Josh Cameron Sunday at 10:27, benched, 33, the third-best score on the roster. Keaton Mitchell started again and scored 4.5. Makai Lemon ($7) 2.25. The perfect lineup, 304.5, loses by 338.25. Fourth low score of the season, fourth $50 fine, $4 of FAAB. 3-8, holding the last Free-For-All spot, and the Scallywags next as a 102.6-point underdog.
takes.0002: 684, a win by 286.5, and back to 8-3. CeeDee Lamb scored 124, Jahmyr Gibbs 114, Geno Smith 106, Jameson Williams 94.75. Pat Freiermuth, picked up Thursday, started and scored 29.75. The leftovers: Xavier Worthy ($1) scored 53.5 on the bench and Brian Thomas Jr., also picked up Thursday, scored 38.5 there, while Malachi Fields (18.75) and Garrett Wilson ($23, 29.25) started. 44 from perfect, which is fine against Prestige. Tied with Trash for first, ahead on points, 7,590 to 7,520.5. BMB next, and MFL has 720 by 209.7, the biggest spread of the week.
takes.0003: Lost to a 1-9 team that was 232.7-point underdogs. Chuba Hubbard ($5) scored 116 and Jayden Daniels 99.75. Josh Allen ($44) 76. Then the rest. Jonathan Taylor, $37, 15. DK Metcalf 1.5. Michael Mayer 3. Chris Rodriguez scored 23.75 on the bench. The perfect lineup, 497.75, still loses by 154. 7-4, out of the tie for first, and sitting sixth, the last playoff spot, one game ahead of Resistance. They play Resistance next, favored by 14.4.
takes.0004: 729.5, the second-best score of the week, and a win by 265.5. Jonah Coleman ($4) scored 144, Mahomes 141, Mike Evans ($9) 106.75, Emmett Johnson 106 in his second straight start. Then there's the bench: Fernando Mendoza scored 127.75 there while Caleb Williams ($22) started for 80.75. Travis Etienne ($19) scored 38 there while Kyle Monangai started for 9. And the waiver wire: $51 to reclaim Dallas Goedert, cut a week earlier, and $31 on Elic Ayomanor to replace Mack Hollins, last week's $51 claim. $164 in two weeks, $148 left. 7-4, two straight, and Nuts next, favored by 157.2.
takes.0005: 788, the high score of the week. Dak Prescott scored 190.75, the best individual score in the league. Purdy 123.75, McConkey 77.75, Olave 76.5, Kittle 75.5, Bateman ($1) 75.25, Cook 71.75. Rachaad White started and scored 0.00, and Simi Fehoko, picked up Friday, scored 30 on the bench. The cost of Fehoko: Cooper Kupp, cut after two straight weeks on the bench behind Tre Tucker. Tucker scored 37.5 this time. 30 from perfect, 8-3, two straight, $650 of FAAB. Prestige next, favored by 186.9.
takes.0006: First win since Week 1. MFL had the Ligers by 232.7, the biggest spread of the week, and Nuts won by 176.25. Ashton Jeanty scored 132, Baker Mayfield 104.75, D.J. Moore 93.25 in the lineup after 94.5 on the bench last week, Trevor Lawrence 78.75, Zay Flowers 66.25. The only miss: Keon Coleman scored 12.75 on the bench while Brenton Strange started for 12. That's 0.75 from perfect. The nine-game streak is over. 2-9, $0 of FAAB, and the Wet Bandits next as a 157.2-point underdog.
takes.0007: Three straight wins. 535 was the lowest winning score of the week, and it beat a perfect lineup by 21.25. Jared Goff scored 115.75, C.J. Stroud 112, Bucky Irving 83, Carnell Tate 68.5. Justin Herbert ($28) scored 113.75 on the bench, 1.75 more than Stroud. Dalton Schultz, an $11 waiver claim Wednesday, started and scored 8.25. 1.75 from perfect. 5-6, ninth, inside the Free-For-All, and Bloodfeast next, with the Scallywags favored by 102.6.
takes.0008: Cam Ward started. Cam Ward scored 118.5. Last week he scored 107.25 on the bench, and this publication said he goes in the lineup. Javonte Williams ($14) added 101.5, Antonio Williams 91.5, Khalil Shakir ($2) 76.75, Nico Collins 68.5. Chigoziem Okonkwo ($2) scored 49.5 on the bench while Tre Harris ($1) started for 21. 28.5 from perfect. Beat Bloodfeast by 381, the third-biggest margin of the season. 7-4, fifth, and the Diamond Dogs next. MFL has Wad by 23.5, the closest spread of the week.
takes.0009: Lost by 265.5. Joe Burrow scored 114.5 and Aaron Rodgers ($1) 91.25. Mike Gesicki scored 57.75, and last week this publication said he wasn't a starter, so that one's on us. The rest is on Resistance. Justice Hill ($1) scored 69.75 on the bench. Cyrus Allen scored 30.75 on the bench for the second straight week. Ja'Kobi Lane, who scored 45.75 on the bench last week, started this week and scored 0.00. The perfect lineup, 554, still loses by 175.5. 6-5, tied with the Diamond Dogs atop the division but behind them on points, and the Ligers next as a 14.4-point underdog.
takes.0010: $524 on Joe Milton Wednesday. Bloodfeast claimed him for $36 three weeks ago and cut him for Drew Lock last week. Milton started and scored 38.75. Tommy DeVito, a $13 claim the same night, was cut Thursday morning for Daniel Jones, who started and scored 27.5. Last week's preview said start Kamara, Downs and Tyson. Tyson started and scored 6.5. Kamara (26.25) and Downs (44.25) sat, along with Devaughn Vele ($1, 57). George Pickens scored 104.5. 397.5, 2-9, two straight losses, $160 of FAAB, and Trash next as a 186.9-point underdog.
takes.0011: A perfect lineup, 513.75, and a loss by 21.25. Last week's preview said start Kyle McCord if BMB learned anything. They started him. He scored 20, and it was still the right call, which tells you about the bench. Tetairoa McMillan scored 78.25, Parker Washington 77.25, Malik Nabers 66.25, Saquon Barkley ($45) 62.5, Justin Jefferson ($29) 55. Luther Burden ($10) 9. Three straight losses, 5-6, eighth, and 720 next as a 209.7-point underdog, the biggest spread of the week.
takes.0012: The four-game streak is over. Lost to Trash by 259.25. Courtland Sutton ($12) started and scored 0.00. Xavier Hutchinson started for 9.75. Jacory Croskey-Merritt scored 69.25 on the bench while D'Andre Swift ($23) started for 46.5. Tank Dell, the $350 claim, scored 20.25 on the bench. Ja'Marr Chase ($33) 23.25. Travis Kelce ($2) 105.5 and Bryce Young 92.5 kept it respectable. The perfect lineup, 608.5, still loses by 179.5. 6-5, still first in the division on points over Resistance, and Wad of Hell next, 23.5-point underdogs.

Team of the Week.text: Beat the Ligers by 176.25 as 232.7-point underdogs, 0.75 from a perfect lineup. First win since Week 1, nine-game streak over.

Biggest Bust.text: 261.75, the lowest score of the season. Six moves in four days, a Sunday pickup benched for 33, and the perfect lineup still loses by 338.25. Fourth $50 fine.

Luckiest Win.text: 535, the lowest winning score of the week, against a BMB lineup that was perfect. Won by 21.25, the closest game of the week.

threads: Standings after Wk 11: E720 and FBT 8-3 (E720 first on PF, 7,590 to 7,520.5); Wet Bandits, Wad, Ligers 7-4; DD and Viva 6-5 (DD leads malort on PF); BMB and Scally 5-6; Bloodfeast 3-8; Nuts and Prestige 2-9.
Playoff picture (2 weeks left): division leaders E720, FBT, DD; best-record spots Wet Bandits, Wad, Ligers. Free-For-All: Viva 7th, BMB 8th, Scally 9th, Bloodfeast 10th. Out: Nuts, Prestige.
Streaks: Scally W3; FBT, Wet Bandits W2; E720, Wad, Nuts W1 (Nuts' L9 snapped); BMB L3; Bloodfeast, Prestige L2; Ligers, DD, Viva L1.

Wk 11 high: FBT 788 (Dak 190.75 top individual). Low: Bloodfeast 261.75, season low (prev Prestige 274.5 Wk 1); Bloodfeast's 4th low-score fine ($200). Biggest margin: Wad +381 (3rd of season). Closest: Scally over BMB by 21.25. Perfect: BMB 513.75 (lost). Nuts 0.75 off, Scally 1.75 off.
Upset: Nuts beat Ligers by 176.25 as 232.7-pt underdogs; first win since Wk 1. D.J. Moore started (93.25).

Bloodfeast moves Thu-Sun: Myles Price, Mayer (cut Burks), Jalon Daniels (cut Drew Lock), Andrews (cut Shaheed, started 10.5), Josh Johnson Sun (cut Daniels, 61.25), Josh Cameron Sun 10:27 (cut Mayer, bench 33). FAAB $4.
Prestige: $524 waiver on Joe Milton (Bloodfeast's old $36 claim), 38.75. DeVito $13 Wed, cut Thu for Daniel Jones (27.5). Started Tyson 6.5; benched Kamara 26.25, Downs 44.25, Vele 57. FAAB $160.
Wet Bandits: $51 Goedert (cut Wk 10) + $31 Ayomanor, cutting Kiner and Hollins (last week's $82). $164 in 2 weeks, $148 left. Mendoza 127.75 on bench. Emmett Johnson 106 (2nd straight start).

FBT cut Cooper Kupp Fri for Simi Fehoko (bench 30). Rachaad White started 0.00. $100 waiver on RJ Harvey Wed. Wad started Cam Ward (118.5) after Wk 11 preview. Viva: Gesicki 57.75 (preview said bench him), Justice Hill 69.75 and Cyrus Allen 30.75 on bench, Lane started 0.00.

DD: Sutton started 0.00, Croskey-Merritt 69.25 and Tank Dell 20.25 on bench; W4 snapped. E720: BTJ picked up Thu, benched 38.5; Worthy 53.5 bench. Scally: Herbert 113.75 on bench by 1.75 over Stroud. BMB started McCord (20) per preview.

0004-0002.head: Game of the Week: the new leader hosts the week's high scorer
0004-0002.text: 720 (6-2) just beat Trash by 288 with a perfect lineup and leads the league with 5,469 points. The Wet Bandits (5-3) just scored 793, the best of the week. MFL has 720 by 15.8, the closest spread of the week. The Wet Bandits lead the series 10-6, but 720 has won the last two, 822.25–510.75 last year and 817.75–683.25 in Week 3. Gibbs, Pollard and Geno Smith against Tee Higgins, Patrick Mahomes and Michael Wilson. The Wet Bandits' tiebreaker: start Emmett Johnson this time.

0001-0003.head: Bloodfeast faces its own quarterback
0001-0003.text: Bloodfeast (2-6) sold Jayden Daniels and Stefon Diggs to the Ligers (6-2) on Wednesday. Now it plays them. MFL has the Ligers by 205.5, the biggest spread of the week. Bloodfeast leads the series 19-15, but the Ligers won the last two, 773–491.25 last year and 608–442.5 in Week 3. The Ligers' biggest threat is their own lineup decisions: Josh Allen, Daniels or Kirk Cousins, who scored 148.25 on the bench last week. Bloodfeast has Daniel Jones.

0012-0011.head: The hottest team in the league against the most frustrating one
0012-0011.text: BMB (5-3) has won five straight. The Diamond Dogs (4-4) have won two straight while benching 479.25 points over those two weeks. MFL has BMB by 44.4. BMB leads the series 14-12, but the Diamond Dogs won Week 3 679–413. Bhayshul Tuten, Drake Maye and Demario Douglas against Ja'Marr Chase, Harold Fannin and Jaxon Smith-Njigba. If the Diamond Dogs ever start Bo Nix, this could get ugly.

0005-0007.head: Trash needs a bounce-back, and the Scallywags are right there
0005-0007.text: Trash (6-2) lost by 288 with a perfect lineup. The Scallywags (2-6) benched Tyler Allgeier's 181.5. MFL has Trash by 153.3. The series is 2-2, and Trash won Week 3 786.5–610.25. Dak Prescott, James Cook and Josh Jacobs should be enough, as long as Tre Tucker remembers how to score. For the Scallywags: start Allgeier.

0009-0010.head: Prestige is favored. Really.
0009-0010.text: Prestige (1-7) just won its first game. Resistance (5-3) just got 240.5 from Joe Burrow. MFL has Prestige by 81.7 anyway. Resistance leads the series 17-15 and won Week 3 637.75–507, but Prestige took last year's game 569–461. Braelon Allen and Kyler Murray against Burrow, Jaylen Warren and Mike Gesicki. If Prestige wins two straight, it's no longer a fluke. It's a trend.

0006-0008.head: Nuts try to stop the bleeding
0006-0008.text: Nuts (1-7) have lost seven straight, scored 327 and traded away Tony Pollard. Wad of Hell (5-3) benched Cam Ward's 138.5 last week. MFL has Wad by 123.8. Nuts lead the series 15-12, but Wad has won the last four, including 785.75–577.5 in Week 3. Jordan Love, Trey McBride and Bijan Robinson against Trevor Lawrence, Ashton Jeanty and Jaylen Waddle. Nuts: start D.J. Moore.

0003-0002.head: Game of the Week: the leader hosts the team that fell out of first
0003-0002.text: 720 (7-2) just scored 800.75, the best of the week, and sits alone in first. The Ligers (6-3) have lost two straight, the second to the team that sold them their quarterback. MFL has 720 by 52.1. The Ligers lead the series 20-9 and won both meetings last year, 877.25–630.5 and 670.5–511.75. CeeDee Lamb, Christian Watson and a $2 Shedeur Sanders against Josh Allen, Jayden Daniels and Brock Bowers. The Ligers' biggest opponent remains the Ligers' lineup.

0005-0008.head: Two 6-3 teams, one going the wrong way
0005-0008.text: Trash (6-3) has lost two straight and started a player who didn't play. Wad of Hell (6-3) just won by 389.75. MFL has Trash by 96.5 anyway. Wad leads the series 16-13. Last year they split three games: Wad 551.75–423.25, Trash 889.5–525.5, Wad 782.25–689. Brock Purdy, Dak Prescott and James Cook against Jordan Love, Bijan Robinson and Javonte Williams. Trash: check the injury report this time.

0011-0009.head: The closest spread of the week
0011-0009.text: BMB (5-4) just saw its five-game streak end. Resistance (5-4) just lost to Prestige by benching a $1 running back's 72.75. MFL has BMB by 9.1. Resistance leads the series 18-13 and won both meetings last year, 626.5–512 and 682–653.5. Drake Maye and Luther Burden against Joe Burrow and Justice Hill, assuming Resistance has learned where Hill goes. BMB: Demario Douglas scored 76.5 on your bench. Start him.

0001-0004.head: Bloodfeast tries for two straight
0001-0004.text: Bloodfeast (3-6) just beat the Ligers with a $36 waiver quarterback. The Wet Bandits (5-4) just lost to 720 with Emmett Johnson on the bench again. MFL has the Wet Bandits by 20.9. Bloodfeast leads the series 11-4 and won 755–576 in 2024 and both meetings last year, the second 624.5–610. Puka Nacua against Kenneth Walker III and Patrick Mahomes. Wet Bandits: we've stopped asking about Emmett Johnson.

0012-0010.head: Prestige goes for three
0012-0010.text: Prestige (2-7) has won two straight. The Diamond Dogs (5-4) have won three straight and finally started Bo Nix. MFL has the Diamond Dogs by 51.6. Prestige leads the series 16-14 and won both meetings last year, 850.5–635.25 and 727.25–709.75. Ja'Marr Chase and Bo Nix against Michael Penix Jr. and Matthew Stafford. If the Diamond Dogs bench 145 points again, this one gets interesting.

0007-0006.head: Nuts host the one team that might let them win
0007-0006.text: Nuts (1-8) have lost eight straight and just scored 277.75. The Scallywags (3-6) just got 221 from C.J. Stroud. MFL has the Scallywags by 92.7. The Scallywags lead the series 2-1, but Nuts won last year's second meeting 513.25–419.25, which is the most encouraging thing anyone can say about Nuts right now. Trevor Lawrence and Ashton Jeanty against Stroud, Matthew Golden and Bucky Irving. Nuts: maybe not Emanuel Wilson.

0008-0001.head: Wad of Hell visits the week's lowest scorer
0008-0001.text: Bloodfeast (3-7) just scored 408.25 and paid the penalty pool. Wad of Hell (6-4) just lost by 339.75 with 148.75 points on the bench. MFL has Wad by 138. Bloodfeast leads the series 17-7 and won the last meeting 784.75–473.75 last year, after Wad won the first 462–337.75. Bijan Robinson, Drake London and Nico Collins against Isaiah Likely, J.J. McCarthy and whoever Bloodfeast picks up Sunday at 12:41. Wad: Cam Ward goes in the lineup.

0010-0002.head: 720 gets the softest landing in the league
0010-0002.text: 720 (7-3) just lost first place outright to the Ligers. Prestige (2-8) just benched a win. MFL has 720 by 190.1. 720 leads the series 10-9 and has won the last three, including 804–663.75 last year. Jahmyr Gibbs and CeeDee Lamb against George Pickens and Omarion Hampton. Prestige: start Kamara, Downs and Tyson, then see what happens.

0006-0003.head: The biggest spread of the week
0006-0003.text: Nuts (1-9) have lost nine straight and just spent $721 on a 7.5-point quarterback. The Ligers (7-3) just scored 802.5. MFL has the Ligers by 232.7. The Ligers lead the series 12-10, but Nuts won last year's meeting 698.25–636.25, which Nuts fans are allowed to bring up. Josh Allen, Jayden Daniels and Chuba Hubbard against Trevor Lawrence and Cam Skattebo. The Ligers' only threat is their own bench, which scored 77 more than their lineup needed last week.

0009-0004.head: The Wet Bandits have found their running back
0009-0004.text: The Wet Bandits (6-4) just started Emmett Johnson and got 153. Resistance (6-4) just won with the lowest winning score of the week. MFL has the Wet Bandits by 69.6. The Wet Bandits lead the series 9-2 and have won the last three, the most recent 474–450.75 last year. Mahomes and Johnson against Joe Burrow and Derrick Henry. Resistance: Mike Gesicki is not a starter.

0012-0005.head: Game of the Week: the season high against the hottest team
0012-0005.text: Trash (7-3) just scored 951.5, the most by anyone this season. The Diamond Dogs (6-4) have won four straight and just played a perfect lineup. MFL has Trash by 8.5, the closest spread of the week. Trash leads the series 10-9, but the Diamond Dogs won last year's meeting 706.75–680.5. McCaffrey, Purdy and Prescott against Ja'Marr Chase and Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Trash: Cooper Kupp over Tre Tucker. It's not complicated.

0007-0011.head: The Scallywags are favored. Read that again.
0007-0011.text: The Scallywags (4-6) have won two straight. BMB (5-5) has lost two straight, the last one with a winning lineup on its bench. MFL has the Scallywags by 12.7. BMB has won both meetings, 742.25–637 in 2024 and 757.25–500.5 last year. Goff, Stroud and Deebo Samuel against Parker Washington and Drake Maye, or Kyle McCord, if BMB learned anything.

0012-0008.head: Game of the Week: a division leader at a wild card, and the closest spread
0012-0008.text: The Diamond Dogs (6-5) lead their division on points and just had a four-game streak snapped. Wad of Hell (7-4) finally started Cam Ward and won by 381. MFL has Wad by 23.5, the closest spread of the week. The Diamond Dogs lead the series 13-6 and won last year's meeting 833–526.25. Ja'Marr Chase, Travis Kelce and Bryce Young against Cam Ward, Nico Collins and Javonte Williams. The Diamond Dogs: Jacory Croskey-Merritt over Courtland Sutton.

0003-0009.head: A rematch of the 2023 title game, with sixth place on the line
0003-0009.text: The Ligers (7-4) hold the last playoff spot. Resistance (6-5) is one game behind, in seventh. Win and Resistance pulls even. MFL has the Ligers by 14.4. The Ligers lead the series 16-8 and have won the last three, including 722.5–624.5 in the 2023 championship. Josh Allen, Jayden Daniels and Chuba Hubbard against Joe Burrow, Derrick Henry and Mike Gesicki. Both teams just lost games their perfect lineups also lose.

0005-0010.head: Trash heads to Prestige with first place at stake
0005-0010.text: Trash (8-3) is tied with 720 for first and trails by 69.5 points. Prestige (2-9) just paid $524 for 38.75 points. MFL has Trash by 186.9. Prestige leads the series 13-9 and won two of the last three, by 2.25 in 2023 and 25 in 2024, but Trash took last year's 800.25–637.25. Dak Prescott, Brock Purdy and James Cook against George Pickens and Omarion Hampton. Prestige: Alvin Kamara and Josh Downs.

0011-0002.head: BMB needs a win, and it's the biggest spread of the week
0011-0002.text: BMB (5-6) has lost three straight, the last one with a perfect lineup. 720 (8-3) is tied for first and leads the league in points. MFL has 720 by 209.7. BMB leads the series 11-8, but 720 has won the last three, including 734–586.25 last year. CeeDee Lamb, Jahmyr Gibbs and Geno Smith against Tetairoa McMillan, Parker Washington and Saquon Barkley. 720: Xavier Worthy is a starter.

0006-0004.head: Nuts try to start a streak of the good kind
0006-0004.text: Nuts (2-9) just won for the first time since Week 1, as 232.7-point underdogs. The Wet Bandits (7-4) just won by 265.5 with 127.75 points of Fernando Mendoza on the bench. MFL has the Wet Bandits by 157.2. Nuts lead the series 7-4, but the Wet Bandits won last year 376.25–362.5. Ashton Jeanty and Baker Mayfield against Mahomes, Jonah Coleman and Emmett Johnson. Wet Bandits: the quarterback decision is Mendoza.

0001-0007.head: The season's lowest score visits the league's longest winning streak
0001-0007.text: Bloodfeast (3-8) just scored 261.75, the lowest of the season, and holds the last Free-For-All spot. The Scallywags (5-6) have won three straight and sit one spot ahead. MFL has the Scallywags by 102.6. Bloodfeast leads the series 2-1, but the Scallywags won last year 679.25–494.75. Jared Goff, Bucky Irving and Carnell Tate against J.J. McCarthy and whoever Bloodfeast adds Sunday morning. Bloodfeast: if you pick someone up, start him.
